scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd extension build
scripts.dev: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd extension dev
scripts.lint: bunx prettier --check . && bunx eslint extension/src extension/vite.config.ts scripts tests && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && bun test tests/unit && bun run test:wasm
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && bun run build:test-extension && bun tests/browser-smoke.ts
scripts.verify: bun run icons:check && bun run notices:check && bun run lint && bun run build:wasm && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run test:browser
scripts.build:test-extension: bun run build:wasm && bun run --cwd extension build:test
